rubric.name: Relevant support experience
rubric.guidance: Years in CS/call centre/e-commerce support, ticket volume, complexity.

rubric.name: Tools & process familiarity
rubric.guidance: Zendesk or similar ticketing, CRM, documented workflows.

rubric.name: Language & communication
rubric.guidance: Clarity of writing; multilingual is a plus for this role.

rubric.name: Motivation & growth signals
rubric.guidance: Concrete motivation only when backed by some evidence; pure enthusiasm without experience scores low here.
